retrievalProfile.description: A 1960s-style album layout featuring a high-contrast male portrait against a solid warm yellow background with heavy, blocky sans-serif headers.

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition dominated by a vibrant mustard-yellow field, featuring a right-aligned male portrait in a dark suit and white ruffled collar, topped by massive, ultra-bold black sans-serif typography and secondary red display text.
coreVisualRelationships: Heavy black header anchoring the top edge
Subject positioned in the lower right quadrant looking toward the viewer
Vibrant yellow negative space occupying the left half
Secondary red text providing a warm color contrast against the yellow
coreInvariants: Ultra-extended bold sans-serif typeface for the primary name
Thin horizontal rule separating the primary name from the title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject is medium-close-up, positioned on the right third of the frame, scaled to occupy roughly 40% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive black 'TOM JONES' text at the top serves as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top black text, drop to the red title, then follow the subject's gaze from the right back toward the center-left negative space.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open yellow space on the left side creates balance against the dense portrait and text on the right.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation yellow with high value; typography uses maximum contrast (black) and medium-high contrast (red).

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Ultra-bold, extended sans-serif and rounded display faces
letterConstructionRules: Primary name uses extremely thick strokes with minimal counters
Secondary title uses rounded, soft terminals with high x-height
Tertiary text uses condensed sans-serif for utility
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'O' in the primary name is a wide, horizontal rectangle with rounded corners
The 'S' is tightly coiled and blocky
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between ultra-heavy geometric black sans-serif and friendly, rounded red display type.
graphicDevices: Left-aligned vertical text block for track listing

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme weight and blocky nature of the primary name.
Captures the rounded, friendly feel of the secondary red text.
Matches the mid-century geometric aesthetic of the main header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a man with dark curly hair in a 1960s dark suit and white ruffled shirt, positioned on the right side of a solid mustard-yellow background. Leave the top 20% and left 50% of the frame as empty yellow space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary name in ultra-bold black extended sans-serif at the very top. Draw a thin black horizontal line below it. Place the title in bold rounded red uppercase letters immediately below the line.

verificationChecks: Is the background a solid, flat mustard yellow?
Is the top text extremely heavy and wide?
Is there a thin horizontal line separating the two main text elements?
Is the portrait positioned on the right side?

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the black header is the heaviest visual element.
Verify the red text is legible against the yellow.
Check that the portrait does not overlap the primary header.
Confirm the horizontal rule is perfectly straight and thin.
recipe.reuseFormula: Solid color background + Ultra-bold extended header + Secondary rounded display type + Offset-aligned portrait.
